description: This file defines classes and structures for a downlink baseband processor implementation in a software radio system, including configuration parameters, a symbol buffer class, and the main processor class with methods for processing and setting transmission offsets.

classes.name: downlink_processor_baseband_configuration
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for the downlink baseband processor, including sector ID, subcarrier spacing, cyclic prefix, sampling rate, number of transmit ports, and slot notification timing.

classes.name: detail::baseband_symbol_buffer
classes.description: Manages a buffer for a single OFDM symbol, allowing reading, writing, and querying available samples.

classes.name: downlink_processor_baseband_impl
classes.description: Implements a software-based downlink baseband processor, capable of processing resource grids, managing buffers, and controlling transmission timing.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the processor to a notifier for event callbacks.

methods.name: get_cfo_control
methods.description: Returns a reference to the Carrier Frequency Offset processor control interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the current state at a given timestamp, performing downlink processing tasks.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets the transmission time offset in samples for the processor.
